> Kinetic Horizons is a lightweight yet powerful Fabric modpack built around the incredible Create Mod and its best add-ons. Designed for smooth performance on both low-end and high-end PCs, this pack lets you build factories, automate everything, and explore with trains, gears, and jetpacks – all without the usual lag.

Whether you're crafting complex machinery, automating mob farms, or building a sprawling rail network with Create: Steam 'n' Rails, Kinetic Horizons offers the perfect blend of technical creativity and performance optimization.
